messages:
alex: noticed ambiguous wording in /audit/privileged-logs: it says \"90 days default\" and also \"customer-managed TTL\". plus Ruby snippet uses deprecated call.
maria: can you paste the exact lines? i'll open a PR.
alex: retention sentence: \"We retain privileged audit logs for 90 days by default; customers can configure TTL via the API.\" ruby example shows `client.audit.export` (old).
kevin: propose precise SOC2-friendly phrasing: \"Tenant-configurable retention period (default: 90 days). Exports supported for audits. Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval.\"
jamal: @docs-bot run link-check on /audit/**.
docs-bot: running link-check, results in a few minutes.
alex: add a compact JSONL example showing pseudonymized IDs for privileged_event.
maria: JSONL sample for docs:
{"event_type":"privileged_event","user_id":"pseudonym:U_ab12","action":"grant_key","timestamp":"2026-01-10T14:00:00Z","details":{"target":"storage-1"}}
kevin: looks good; add parenthetical that Redwood admins do not have plaintext tenant data except under documented emergency procedures.
maria: opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4281 1 preview soon.
docs-bot: link-check complete 1 found two 404s: /sdk/ruby/audit_export and /examples/jsonl-schema.
maria: will add redirects for old SDK paths and fix example URL.
sophia-legal: quick legal review: prefer \"tenant-configurable retention period\" language and add internal playbook link for emergency access. approve after tiny edits.
maria: updated per legal and added redirect rules. final copy: \"Tenant-configurable retention period (default 90 days). Exports supported for audits. Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval.\"
alex: thanks, merge after CI. i'll notify SDK owners about method rename.
jamal: i'll verify redirects post-merge and close related support tickets.
maria: merged, closing thread.
